summary: You can look something emotionally complex square in the face without letting it hijack your entire afternoon, which makes radical honesty a lot easier than avoidance.
body: You can look something emotionally complex square in the face without letting it hijack your entire afternoon, which makes radical honesty a lot easier than avoidance. When the Moon trines Pluto, deep psychological currents become easier to tolerate, helping you acknowledge the resentment, fear, attachment, or desire underneath a dynamic without needing to suppress it or blow it up into a crisis. Once you admit what is actually there, the next move stops being a mystery. You do not need to dramatize the truth for it to change how you operate.
